body_sample:
Features
Blog
Daily Journaling
features.

More than a journaling app, stoic is your go-to resource for exploring stoicism and philosophy, mental well-being, happiness, productivity, relationships, and practical tips for living a fulfilled life.

Journaling Inspiration and Guidance
Daily Reflections

Begin and end your day with easily customizable reflections to keep your self-care practice intentional and fulfilling.

Daily Prompts

Not sure what to journal about? Daily prompts are here to inspire you. Keep an eye out for a new prompt each day, and a new theme every week.

Guided Journals

Explore a collection of thematic guided journals on topics that matter most. Revisit and explore them anytime.

Helpful Tools for Building Your Habit
Progress Tracking

Monitor your mood and mark the factors that influence it. Soon, you'll discover patterns and get insights to help you feel your best.

Streaks & Badges

With fun rewards, staying motivated is easy! Build your streaks and unlock badges along the way. Can you collect them all?

Gentle Notifications

Set smart reminders so you don't forget to log your mood or journal to stay consistent without disrupting your day.

Write Your Own Journey
Journaling History

Take a trip down memory lane whenever you want. Revisit your past entries to see how far you’ve come.

Personalized Insights

Get valuable feedback and insights based on your daily entries and activities to better understand what influences your life.

Treasured Memories

Go back to the most meaningful moments of your life and reflect on the memories that matter most.

Mindful Exercises
Meditation

Practice mindfulness through guided meditation sessions designed to center and calm your mind.

Breathing

Enter Habitica
Build better habits one level at a time!
Gamify your life

Habitica is the perfect app for anyone who struggles with to-do lists. We use familiar game mechanics like rewarding you with Gold, Experience, and items to help you feel productive and boost your sense of accomplishment when you complete tasks. The better you are at your tasks, the more you progress in the game.

Gear up in style

Collect swords, armor, and much more with the Gold you earn from completing tasks. With hundreds of pieces to collect and choose from, you'll never run out of combinations to try. Optimize for stats, style, or both!

Get rewarded for your effort

Having something to look forward to can be the difference between getting a task done, or having it taunt you for weeks. When life doesn't offer a reward, Habitica has you covered! You’ll be rewarded for every task, but surprises are around every corner–so keep up your progress!

Team up with friends
Social productivity

Get a boost of motivation by collaborating, competing, and interacting with others! Habitica is built to harness the most effective part of any self-improvement program: social accountability.

Battle monsters on Quests

Take on one of our hundreds of Quests with a Party of friends to enter the fray. Quest monsters push your accountability to the max. Forgetting to floss means damage done to everyone!

Challenge each other

Join Challenges made by our community to get curated task lists that fit your interests and goals. Do your best to compete for the Gem prize awarded to the winner!
